description: Incident Report Generator (app/services/reporting) input. This file contains NO report text. The real ReportContextBuilder reads the persisted correlation, detections, risk assessment, threat-intel indicators/lookups, incident memories, overlapping threat hunts, approvals and SOAR executions for a correlation id resolved at run time, and only then does the real generator call the LLM. Every citation the model returns is validated against the built record catalog: a dangling citation rejects the whole output.

expected_availability_markers.note: The builder distinguishes these itself; the dataset never sets them.
expected_availability_markers.NOT_PROVIDED: an input the caller supplied no data source for (e.g. security_events, which SentinelAI does not persist)
expected_availability_markers.NONE_FOUND: the retrieval ran successfully but nothing was cited for that input (e.g. no overlapping hunt, no approval, no SOAR execution)
